content.question_generation_by_class.definition:
SELECT ap_class, COUNT(*)::int AS count,
		COALESCE(SUM(content_length), 0)::int AS total_question_chars
	FROM content.question_registry
	WHERE kind = 'mcq'
	GROUP BY ap_class
content.question_generation_by_class.name: question_generation_by_class
